    Keyboard shortcuts

    K
    Kill the busiest leader (SIGKILL)
    P
    Partition a random node
    L
    30% packet loss on a random node
    H
    Heal everything
    R
    Open the latest incident report
    A
    Open the alert history
    /
    Search the logs
    Esc
    Close dialogs
